name: curb-cut-channels
description: The non-web front doors for Curb Cut: SMS and voice relay, Slack app, MCP server. Each one talks to the same authenticated REST contract.
x-notes: sms-relay.mjs and mcp-server.mjs import @salesforce/core and @salesforce/agents from the globally installed Salesforce CLI (npm root -g). They are not listed here on purpose: the CLI is the one that holds the org login, and it is already required. Set SF_CLI_MODULES if the CLI is installed somewhere unusual.
slack-app.mjs and sms-relay.mjs read the org login from the CLI too, so no credential lives in this folder.
